avoidance: No avoidance trend: later contact rate and damage per equal time increase.
softening: Later individual impacts are gentler than the first; not monotonic and grouping matters.
limitation: Local I effect is tiny and mixed in sign; reduced E-dependent force capacity is a major confounder.

avoidance: No further mover contact; later clearance generally increases.
softening: No later collision to assess softening.
limitation: Single damaging encounter, then repeated noncontact passes; immediate I effects have mixed signs. Injury displacement and drift remain alternatives.

avoidance: Four mover encounters; no steadily increasing recontact interval.
softening: Lower later closing speeds/damage; the second encounter has greater total impulse.
limitation: All three later episode-approach probes reduce into-surface force and increase mean attenuation, but effects are small and geometry/phase/E differ.

avoidance: Later near miss followed by greater clearance; no recontact.
limitation: All eight nonzero age-block probes reduce into-surface force. One physical encounter plus tiny restoration does not establish a learned avoidance policy.

avoidance: Greater later clearance and no recontact, despite some close later passes.
softening: No repeated impact opportunity for a severity trend.
limitation: Twelve age-block probes shift force more into the mover, two less; observed separation cannot be attributed to beneficial learned-I action.

avoidance: Only one impact; subsequent passes remain separated.
limitation: Most later I probes favor less approach, but later full age-block minima already exceed 0.36 units. No repeated-contact adaptation trend is available.

avoidance: Second mover encounter occurs; later source recontacts also occur.
softening: Mover contact worsens; later source contacts are somewhat softer.
limitation: Different colliders and energy transfer must not be pooled into one success. Learned-I directions are mixed.

avoidance: Longer later gaps and eventual absence, confounded by opportunity and drift.
softening: Second wall impact is worse; third returns near first severity.
limitation: Learned-I increases into-surface drive in both later episode-approach probes.

avoidance: No contact after 185.73 s, but this alone does not establish learned avoidance.
softening: The three repair-surface impacts get harder and more damaging.
limitation: This category applies to the observed softening claim: both later approach probes increase into-surface drive. It is not a universal refutation of I learning.
